ambiguities.source_text: Bring all the year tables together into a single table
ambiguities.intent: Append all thirteen standardized year tables, retaining every athlete-year row. Map Nation/Nationality/Country to Country, Total/Total earnings to Total earnings and Salary/winnings to Salary/Winnings. Read each monetary column independently; do not recompute Total earnings as the other two fields summed. Monetary comparison accepts at most0.000001 dollar absolute floating serialization error; cent-level errors are rejected.

ambiguities.source_text: Bring in the source information so that it is associated with each row
ambiguities.intent: Read the source URL from input_14.csv and repeat it on all output rows. The source table is metadata, not another athlete table.
